title: Open Hillside access and choose a workspace
description: Find your way around the training project: the active road, a station on it, and the same work in another workspace interface.

setup.goal: Find the active road and a station on it, and switch workspace interface without losing either.
audience: Forest road designers new to PGMaps
access: None: the lesson opens the synthetic training project, which needs no sign-in and no data download.
setup.startingScreen: The road designer on the Hillside access training project, at station 0+000 with the cross-section shown.
limitations: The readings are those of the synthetic training terrain and the Hillside access roads as shipped.

overlay.title: Hillside access on the plan
overlay.body: This is Hillside access, a road on synthetic training ground. The project also holds a second road, Contour alternative. Every lesson starts from this project, and a reload starts it fresh.

overlay.title: A training project
overlay.body: The Synthetic training badge in the header says the ground is made up for practice: its numbers are not survey data. Anything you change here is gone when the page reloads, unless you save a copy (Save and reopen a project shows how).

check.description: Hillside access is the active road

overlay.title: Find the active road
overlay.body: The road selector names the road the drawings show. Choose Hillside access if Contour alternative is showing.

check.description: the Linked overview preset is chosen

overlay.title: Show the linked views
overlay.body: In the screen preset menu, choose Linked overview. The plan, the profile and the cross-section then show the same station side by side.

overlay.title: Mark a station
overlay.body: Type 200 in the Station box and press Enter. The red point labelled 0+200.0 on the plan is 200 metres along Hillside access from its start.

overlay.title: Switch to Guided map
overlay.body: Select Switch workspace interface and choose Guided map. The interfaces arrange the same tools differently; the project stays as it is.

overlay.title: The road and station stay
overlay.body: Guided map shows the same project: Hillside access is still the active road and the station still reads 0+200.

overlay.title: Return to Guided mode
overlay.body: Select Switch workspace interface again and choose Guided mode.
